name: Fourthwall
description: Fourthwall is a platform designed to empower creators by providing them with tools to build and manage their own custom storefronts. It allows creators to sell merchandise, digital products, and memberships directly to their audience, offering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. With Fourthwall, creators can maintain control over their brand and engage with their community more effectively.

events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a product is updated in your Fourthwall store.
Retrieve products with optional search, paginated or all fetch modes, and selectable response fields.
Make a specific product available or unavailable for purchase in your storefront.
Retrieve your shop's promotions by page or all at once, optionally filtered by promotion codes.

Create a membership promotion with multiple coupon codes and configurable discounts (percentage, flat-rate, or free shipping), optional minimum order, product restrictions (not available for free-shipping), and usage…
Retrieve collections with optional search, pagination, and selectable response fields.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever a gift is purchased in your account.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever any order is updated.

Retrieve the connected shop's contact info; returns found=false when no contact exists.
Create a design, digital or customization product with pricing and storefront visibility.
Change a product to public or hidden. Product details and prices are not editable through this action.
Create a product customization from a template with optional artwork, placements, colors, and sizes for previews.
